description: One of our particle shapes: ``realmforge:<id>``, a particle type whose spawns carry their colour.

frames.description: Its frames, first to last over its life, each 8 rows of 8 pixels: '.' is transparent, 1 to f a grey from dark to white that the spawn's colour tints. At most 8 frames.
frames.title: Frames

friction.description: The share of its speed it keeps every tick: 1 never slows, vanilla's default is 0.98.
friction.title: Friction

glows.description: Whether it is drawn at full brightness, as a spark is, instead of in the light where it is.
glows.title: Glows

gravity.description: How hard it falls: 1 falls like a block, 0 floats, less than 0 rises.
gravity.title: Gravity

id.description: Lowercase snake_case id; becomes realmforge:<id>. Must equal the file name.
id.title: Id

lifetime_ticks.description: How long it lives, in ticks: the shortest and the longest, each spawn in between. At most 40.
lifetime_ticks.title: Lifetime Ticks

size.description: Half its width in blocks (vanilla's quad size), at most 0.5; vanilla's are about 0.1.
size.title: Size

title: ParticleDef
